Screenshot 1 shows BBC cookie modal blocking content.
screenshot.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the screenshot evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

criteria.criterion: Record the five most recent BBC Technology headlines

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Record the five most recent BBC Technology headlines
evidence_items.expected_value: Criterion-relevant browser state and final task claim

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Screenshot 2 (latest BBC state) shows at most one partially visible headline ('More companies are promoting staff…') and does not show a full list of five recent headlines. Screenshot 3 (latest overall) shows the agent on dzbank.com with a privacy settings modal—no BBC headlines. Predicted output is a RunnerError with no headlines listed.
screenshot.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the screenshot evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX:1 shows some headline-like strings on the BBC Technology page (e.g., 'OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours', 'More companies are promoting staff based on their AI skills. Is it fair?', 'New UK law to force tech firms to stop children taking or sharing nude images', ''Good to have choice': Australians on opting out of social media algorithms', and 'Keeping Tabs'/'How to watch the cameras that watch you' appear in a concatenated block). However, neither DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX:0 nor :1 explicitly indicates these are the five most recent items, and the agent’s final output contains no recorded list at all (only a RunnerError). DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX:2 is off-site (dzbank.com) and contains no BBC headlines.
dom_model.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the DOM evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in and no ad interaction

evidence_items.evidence_requirement: Respect constraints: no sign-in and no ad interaction
evidence_items.expected_value: Criterion-relevant browser state and final task claim

screenshot.verifier_evidence_excerpt: Screenshots 1 and 2 show 'Register'/'Sign In' links but no sign-in flow initiated. Screenshot 2 shows an 'ADVERTISEMENT' label present; there is no direct visual evidence of a click on the ad itself. However, action history shows State 2 at https://www.dzbank.com/... immediately after clicking a ref on the BBC Technology page, consistent with an off-site navigation that could plausibly be an ad click.
screenshot.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the screenshot evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.

dom_model.verifier_evidence_excerpt: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX:1 shows 'Register'/'Sign In' links but no evidence of entering a sign-in flow. It also explicitly shows 'Advertisement' labels on the BBC page. Action history plus DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX:2 show the browser on dzbank.com after a click, consistent with (though not conclusively proving) an ad click or other external redirect. No DOM evidence shows the agent sharing/commenting or otherwise interacting with ads beyond the off-site navigation.
dom_model.review_note: Manual inspection confirmed that the DOM evidence and the verifier interpretation agree.
